title: 42-row B.V. Raman Shadbala source evidence ledger
source: B.V. Raman, Graha and Bhava Balas, 13th edition (1992), 1918 Standard Horoscope

sourceDiscrepancies.detail: Mercury Dig arc 63°05′ does not divide to printed 21.09.
sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: Example 14 p.32 gives Mercury Digbala arc 63°05′. Example 15 p.33 prints 21.09 and the p.90 final summary repeats 21.09.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: Do not silently treat 21.09 as formula-derived. The book's final summary and current 1918 worked-example totals use 21.09; the explicit printed arc divided by three yields about 21.03. Keep the historical example conflict open.

sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: §104 p.77 table lists Saturn 151.23°. Example 49 p.78 substitutes 181.23° and obtains Chesta Kendra 63.42° / Chesta Bala 21.14; p.90 summary also gives 21.14.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: For the 1918 Standard Horoscope worked example, 181.23° is the reproducible input that matches the printed Chesta result and final summary. The conflicting §104 table cell remains recorded as a source misprint; this is not a universal longitude rule.

sourceDiscrepancies.detail: Chapter VII constant 8.57 versus final summary appears 8.37.
sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: Chapter VII table p.81 and Example 52 p.81 both print 8.57; Example 56 final summary p.90 prints 8.37.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: Use the component table / Example 52 value 8.57 for the 1918 sample. Preserve 8.37 as a final-summary printing error.

sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: Example 55 p.88 gives Drishti Pinda −64.14 and Drik Bala −16.04; Example 56 final summary p.90 prints −16.03.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: The chapter formula and Example 55 support −16.04 under conventional half-away-from-zero rounding; the final summary uses −16.03. Retain the 0.01 source discrepancy until the author's intermediate precision/rounding convention is independently established.

sourceDiscrepancies.detail: Sun printed total 424.24 conflicts with component sum 424.94; Rupa 7.08 supports 424.94.
sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: Example 56 p.89 prints Sun total 424.24 and Rupa 7.08.
sourceDiscrepancies.recomputation: The displayed components sum to 424.94; 424.94 ÷ 60 = 7.0823, which rounds to the printed 7.08. 424.24 ÷ 60 would not produce 7.08.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: The Rupa and component sum support 424.94; 424.24 is retained as the summary total misprint.

sourceDiscrepancies.detail: Example 35 detailed Kala 30.06 versus final summary 33.06; total 298.14/Rupa4.97 reconcile with 30.06.
sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: Example 35 p.62 prints Mars Kala Bala 30.060; Example 56 p.89 prints 33.06.
sourceDiscrepancies.recomputation: 11.68 Natonnatha + 16.54 Paksha + 1.84 Ayana = 30.06. The six-Bala total 298.14 and Rupa 4.97 also reconcile with 30.06.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: Use 30.06 as the component supported by Example 35 and total recomposition; retain 33.06 as a summary-table misprint.

sourceDiscrepancies.printedEvidence: Example 56 p.90 prints Mercury total 537.02 and Rupa 8.85.
sourceDiscrepancies.disposition: The displayed Virupa total mathematically gives 8.95; keep 8.85 flagged as a printed Rupa error.

genericCertification.reason: Rows cover one 1918 worked example, not independent per-natal source proofs; component and summary errata remain open.
